findings.problem: The clean predicate requires primary is None. Therefore a deliberate setup failure, timeout, overflow or ordinary post-reap exception necessarily persists cleanup=failed even when every close, handler restoration and leader reap succeeded with no cleanup interruption or errors. The receipt cannot distinguish failed work with successful cleanup from failed cleanup, contrary to the required separation of primary failure and cleanup outcomes.
findings.required_change: Derive aggregate cleanup solely from observed cleanup/reap/close/restoration outcomes and cleanup interruption. Preserve and re-raise primary independently; successful cleanup must never turn an injected failure into exit zero.
findings.required_e2e: After separate execution approval, use the existing setup-failure, timeout, overflow and post-reap-exception public controls. Where observed cleanup obligations succeed, require nonzero exit plus original failure and cleanup=success. Keep cleanup-interrupt nonzero with cleanup=failed even when its resource obligations complete.

findings.problem: The handler records received.signal locally but never persists it. Cleanup interruption records only a boolean and a generic message; collection interruption also loses the signal identity. signal_attempt omits the ownership phase. Thus lifecycle.json cannot show the required observed SIGINT in the fixed cleanup-interrupt probe or the phase at the actual group-signal attempt; scenario name alone is not an observation.
findings.required_change: Persist a fixed scalar first-signal observation and the phase captured at the sole group-signal attempt, retaining the existing intended/attempted/result fields and separate cleanup-interrupted flag. Do not add a signal log or new fault matrix.
findings.required_e2e: Use existing cleanup-interrupt to require original setup failure, observed SIGINT, cleanup_interrupted=true, cleanup=failed and independent resource/reap outcomes. Existing owned-failure controls must expose phase=owned for an attempted group signal; post-reap controls must show no attempt.
